walkthrough.short: One short line across the set, hands along it, and rock forward and back.
walkthrough.long: The four of you make one short line straight across the set, looking up and down it rather than at each other. The two in the middle take hands there by the {hand}, and each of them gives their other hand to the dancer on their own end of the row, so everybody is looking the opposite way to the dancers beside them. Rock forward together and back, and nobody goes anywhere.
